model: PointNet from scratch; same architecture as best prior real-part run
architecture: shared MLP 3-64-64-64-128-1024, global max pool, 1024-512-256-3 unit-axis head
input: 2048 XYZ surface points; each shape centered and scaled to unit sphere; no normals
reference_pose: Each Magics STL is used directly in its recorded accepted print pose.
target: R@[0,0,1] for point row vectors transformed as P@R.T
metric_scope: Mean signed-axis angle over fixed random rotations of held-out geometry hashes; not an independent project/family test. Symmetry is not corrected.
